statements.quote: The sequential decrease of $2.2B was a result of negative free cash flow of $2.5B, driven by an inventory increase of $2.7B and AI infrastructure capex of $1.0B in Q1.
statements.notes: Quarterly figure (Q1 only), not full fiscal year. The same $1.0B AI infrastructure capex also appears in p01 as a parenthetical fragment, '(AI infrastructure capex was $1.0B in Q1)'; the p02 full sentence is used instead. The sentence names Q1 but no year; the release covers the quarter ended 2024-03-31.

statements.quote: While many are pulling back on their investments, we are investing in future growth – including our AI infrastructure, production capacity, our Supercharger and service networks and new products infrastructure – with $2.8B of capital expenditures in Q1.
statements.notes: Total Q1 capex, with AI infrastructure as one of several purposes. This is not AI spend. Quarterly figure only; the sentence names Q1 but no year.

statements.quote: increase in operating expenses partly driven by AI, cell advancements and other R&D projects
statements.notes: This is a bullet item in a list of YoY operating income drivers, not a standalone punctuated sentence. It attributes part of the YoY increase in total operating expenses to AI and gives no amount.

statements.quote: To further improve our end- to-end training capability, we will continue to increase our core AI infrastructure capacity in the coming months.
statements.notes: The sentence describes expanding AI infrastructure capacity rather than spend explicitly. It is linked to capex because the release reports AI infrastructure as capex elsewhere. 'In the coming months' gives no fiscal year.
